verdict.rationale: Exa's docs have a dedicated OpenAPI spec page that explicitly offers downloadable OpenAPI specs for both the public API and the Team Management API, in YAML or JSON. The probe's 404s were only at guessed root paths (/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json), not at the documented location, so they do not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec files download and are complete, and no discoverable spec at conventional well-known paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Download the OpenAPI specs for the Exa public API and Team Management API in YAML or JSON.
